note: Twenty queries for the Scribe keyterm benchmark (PROMPT 9). Record each one as WAV or MP3 named <id>.wav in this directory. Record REAL dispatchers in the ROOM THEY WORK IN, not a quiet office and not synthesised speech: the whole question is whether keyterm prompting rescues ICAO codes from accented, second-language, noisy audio, and clean studio audio cannot answer it. Swap the ICAO codes, registrations and operator prefixes below for ones this operation actually flies before recording — a benchmark on airports nobody uses measures nothing.
criticalTokenKinds: ICAO codes, aircraft registrations and callsigns. These are scored separately from the rest of the sentence because they are the tokens where a mistake produces a confident wrong answer rather than a visible failure.
